goal.objective:
# Instructions

Implement a clock that handles times without dates.

You should be able to add and subtract minutes to it.

Two clocks that represent the same time should be equal to each other.

Change only `clock.cpp` and `clock.h`, keeping the names the tests use and nothing beyond the standard library, so that `rm -rf build && cmake -S . -B build -DEXERCISM_RUN_ALL_TESTS=1 && cmake --build build` passes in the workspace root; every other file stays as it is.
